name: douyin-lottery-assistant
description: 抖音福袋自动参与助手

scripts.pool:server:go: cd pool-server-go && sh -c 'if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec go run ./cmd/poolserver; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/go/bin/go" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/go/bin/go" run ./cmd/poolserver; else echo "go not found: install Go or add ~/.local/go/bin to PATH"; exit 127; fi'
scripts.pool:learning:replay: cd pool-server-go && sh -c 'if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec go run ./cmd/learning-replay; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/go/bin/go" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/go/bin/go" run ./cmd/learning-replay; else echo "go not found: install Go or add ~/.local/go/bin to PATH"; exit 127; fi'
scripts.electron:build:win: vite build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 && mv "dist-electron/抖音福袋助手 ${npm_package_version}.exe" "dist-electron/抖音福袋助手 ${npm_package_version}-x64.exe" && electron-builder --win portable --arm64 && mv "dist-electron/抖音福袋助手 ${npm_package_version}.exe" "dist-electron/抖音福袋助手 ${npm_package_version}-arm64.exe"
